Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XIII OF 1977
ORDINANCE
XIII OF 1977
BALUCHISTAN WILDLIFE PROTECTION (1ST AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977
An Ordinance to amend the
Baluchistan Wildlife Protection Act, 1974
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 13th December 1977]
No. Legis: 4-25/Law/76 -The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the 12th December,
1977 is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title, extent and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be
called the Baluchistan Wildlife Protection (1st Amendment) Ordinance, 1977.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the Province of Baluchistan except the Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from 22nd July, 1974.
